sloka: ततो वृद्धमुपागम्य नियमेनाभ्यवादयत्।गृह्य जाम्बवतः पादौ हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।। ६.७४.२४ ।।
transliteration: tato vṛddhamupāgamya niyamenābhyavādayat।gṛhya jāmbavataḥ pādau hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।। 6.74.24 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Hanuman the son of the wind god coming close to the aged Jambavan clasped his feet in accordance with tradition and greeted him.
